svg.text: PIC18F16Q20 Curiosity Nano <-> LSF0108 <-> SPI Flash (SOIC-8)
B side (Nano) = 3.3 V, A side (flash) = 1.2 V. Flash VCC must NEVER see 3.3 V. As built: B side 300 Ω, A side 82 Ω. MCU sink current EXCEEDS IOL = 10 mA - see notes below.
Pull-up check (as built: B side 300 Ω, A side 82 Ω, all channels). PIC18F06/16Q20 D360: VOL <= 0.6 V is guaranteed only at IOL = 10 mA.
MCU pin low (VOL = 0 V, worst case): I = 3.3 V / 300 Ω + 1.2 V / 82 Ω = 11.0 + 14.6 = 25.6 mA (> 10 mA: 2.6x IOL) [VOL = 0.175 V: 22.9 mA; VOL = 0.6 V: 16.3 mA]
Estimated VOL (worst-case linear model, Ron = 0.6 V / 10 mA = 60 Ω): VOL = 0.80 V at 13.3 mA - above the 0.6 V spec limit and the flash VIL (0.24~0.36 V).
Flash side: MISO A side is now 82 Ω as well, so the flash SO pin sinks 25.6 mA when it drives low (flash datasheets specify VOL only at IOL = 100 µA).
Pass-transistor current at VOL = 0.35 V: B 9.8 mA, A 10.4 mA - both under the LSF0108 15 mA limit. To get back to <= 10 mA at VOL = 0 V: e.g. B 750 Ω + A 240 Ω = 9.4 mA.
LSF0108: pull-ups are required on the B side; on the A side they are required when the flash pin leaks > 1 µA (datasheet ILI = ±2 µA). Current also flows INTO Vref_A in normal operation:
the external 1.2 V supply must be able to absorb it (add a small load if it cannot sink). Vref_B >= Vref_A + 0.8 V is met (3.3 V vs 1.2 V). No OE pin: EN is the enable.
Fixed on the Nano board (no wiring): RC4 = UART TX, RC5 = UART RX (USB CDC); LED0 = RC7; SW0 = RA2. RB5/RB6 are 1.2 V MVIO pins (I2C/I3C only) - not used.
Power order: USB first, then the external 1.2 V supply. Common GND for Nano, LSF0108, 1.2 V supply and flash. Flash WP# is driven high by firmware (WP# High option in the GUI).
